name: Sahajanand Medical Technologies Limited
summary: Sahajanand Medical Technologies Limited engages in the manufacture and distribution of Class III and Class C/D medical devices in India, Europe, rest of the Asia Pacific, Latin America, and the Middle East and Africa. The company provides vascular intervention products coronary stents and balloons used to diagnose or treat diseases of the blood vessels; structural heart products comprising trans-catheter aortic valves and occluders used to treat defects or abnormalities in the heart's structure; and other products, such as renal stents, peripheral drug-coated balloon catheters, and other trading products.
